purpose: Repository-mediated execution control for O Chat-mode parallel workers. This file does not control or replace the authoritative O Work primary executor.

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.acceptance: Workers can reconstruct latest O state, choose non-conflicting useful leaves, execute all Chat-capable work, persist evidence/continuation, and hand off only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions without duplicating primary execution.
phase.on_acceptance: Set phase.name=phase_2_acceleration and optimize expected time to the unchanged primary O objective. Do not rebuild a new control plane.

problem_solving_contract.source: J-derived mechanism only; J AGI objective explicitly excluded

A.selection_rule: Choose the highest-value unresolved non-conflicting leaf permitted by current O state and current claims; if blocked, switch to another executable non-conflicting leaf.

preferred_scope: patch or PR preparation where Chat connector capability permits
B.selection_rule: Prefer falsifiable verification work that can retire uncertainty before the primary reaches the same frontier.

C.selection_rule: Prefer research or transversal work that can collapse multiple active branches or remove a likely future blocker.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Make the three Chat workers maximally useful within actual Chat capabilities while keeping primary Work execution unchanged.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using only useful non-conflicting Chat-capable parallel work.
required_each_run: Read latest O state, open PRs/issues/checks/CI, active Chat claims/receipts, and this control file.
Inspect actual worker execution evidence rather than trusting prompts.
Update this file to reassign worker scopes or priorities when expected time-to-primary-objective improves.
Do not depend on prompt-only coordination for substantive worker execution changes.
Do not modify the primary O monitor/recovery task unless the user explicitly asks.
